title: Phase 6: Weekly Lab and data rights
goal: Hoàn tất Week 6 theo `TP-PLAN` trên local harness: deterministic Weekly Lab/report, behavioral experiment/completion, product analytics snapshot, export/archive round-trip và workspace deletion/data-rights controls.
nonGoals: Không bật AI, transcription, taxonomy suggestion hoặc weekly summary model; các nhánh AI vẫn empty/disabled cho core profile.
Không triển khai object store, email/webhook, processor hoặc network thật; export/archive/deletion dùng local deterministic payload và absence evidence mô phỏng.
Không triển khai đầy đủ performance profile production 24h/32GiB; Phase 6 local harness chỉ chứng minh contract boundary, idempotency và verifier trong repo.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Weekly Lab tạo `WeeklyCohort`, input revision và report revision deterministic theo workspace timezone, Monday-local half-open interval, locked as-of, homogeneous dependency tuple, chọn MetricSnapshot/Review/Context refs immutable và renderer output không tính metric phía client.

Behavioral experiment và weekly completion có taxonomy `behavioral_experiment_v1`, propose/confirm/cancel append-only, target next regular cohort, uniqueness/idempotency/stale guard và completion precondition gắn đúng report/experiment/cohort.

Product analytics local harness có first-party `product_analytics_event_v1`, workspace product metric snapshots, internal aggregate privacy threshold, external projection/purge records tối thiểu, không chứa raw business content và không vào workspace export ngoài owner-owned first-party source.

Export/data-rights có `tradeproof_export_v1` request/job/revision/manifest deterministic, cutoff/reference closure, spreadsheet-safe CSV convenience entries, STANDARD/OVERSIZE service-class boundary, round-trip validator và `EXPORT_EXPIRY` revocation/delete evidence.

Workspace deletion local harness có `workspace_deletion_v1` request/FENCE, generation increment, target DAG/drain evidence, cancellation of queued work, export/url revocation, primary local purge/tombstone and re-registration suppression within deterministic records.
Phase 6 API/UI/migration/tests/verifier/local CI/CHANGELOG/CI workflow được cập nhật; Phase 0-5 checks vẫn xanh, secret/bin-obj guard pass và UI không thêm AI/exchange sync/trading-signal language.

validationPlan.description: Đọc lại TP-PLAN Week 6, TP-LAB, TP-EXP, TP-SEC data-rights/deletion và TP-AT core gates trước khi edit.
validationPlan.command: Get-Content -Raw docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; Get-Content -Raw docs/WEEKLY_LAB.md; Get-Content -Raw docs/EXPORT_CONTRACT.md; Get-Content -Raw docs/SECURITY_PRIVACY_AI.md; Get-Content -Raw docs/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md

validationPlan.description: Chạy C# harness Phase 6 chứng minh Weekly Lab/report, experiment/completion, product analytics, export/round-trip/expiry và workspace deletion invariants.
Kiểm artifact Phase 6: migration/schema literals, API/UI surface, verifier, CHANGELOG, CI wiring, export/deletion labels và prohibited language.
Chạy local CI Phase 6 gồm restore/build, Phase 0/1/2/3/4/5/6 runners, verifiers và secret/bin-obj scan.
